title: PiWebUiPluginMetadata
description: Metadata definition for a pi-web-ui plugin registry entry

id.description: Unique plugin identifier, matches folder name and install dir

source.description: GitHub repository specifier (owner/repo, owner/repo/subdir[#ref], or full GitHub URL)

author.description: GitHub username or organization of the author

descriptionEn.description: Optional English description of the plugin

homepage.description: Optional project homepage or GitHub tree URL

icon.description: Optional emoji icon for the plugin

iconSvg.description: Optional inline SVG icon (must begin with <svg and end with </svg>, no script/event handlers)
